nodes.label: Immutable Report Snapshot Lineage
nodes.rationale: report_runs.snapshot_data freezes reported values alongside contributing record IDs and exact calculation rows used at generation time.

nodes.label: Report Value Type Mapping
nodes.rationale: Allows mappings to select whether to report calculated emissions or verified activity quantities (deviation D18, migration 0026).

nodes.label: Append-Only Audit Log Trigger
nodes.rationale: Database trigger on audit_logs (migration 0027) blocks UPDATE, DELETE, and TRUNCATE actions even for service role, guaranteeing immutability.

nodes.label: Record Lifecycle Audit Trail
nodes.rationale: Aggregates events from upload, OCR, human edits, approval submission (approval.submitted), and report snapshot inclusion into complete audit trail.

nodes.label: Direct Postgres Transactions via postgres.js
nodes.rationale: Uses postgres.js direct connection via DATABASE_URL to execute atomic multi-table mutations and audit writes in TypeScript transactions.

nodes.label: SEBI BRSR Annexure I Catalogue
nodes.rationale: Adopts official indicator numbering and wording from SEBI Annexure I, seeding only the 9 indicators currently fed by application metrics.

nodes.label: Mandatory BRSR Indicator Enforcement
nodes.rationale: SEBI Section A/B and Essential indicators are strictly mandatory; report generation fails with explicit error naming unmapped indicators.

nodes.label: Admin-Only Account Provisioning
nodes.rationale: Disables public self sign-up (enable_signup = false); accounts are created only by server-side service-role provisioning with profile and org assignment.

nodes.rationale: /admin/scope-2 reuses the Phase 10 Scope 1 component with different scope parameters; record-trace server action moved to lib/scope/actions.ts.

nodes.label: Scope 3 Active Categories

nodes.label: Recursive Scope Rollup Query
nodes.rationale: scope.getTotal rolls up totals across child categories recursively, handling Scope 3 without separate engine query procedures.

nodes.label: Spend-Based Business Travel
nodes.rationale: Calculates business travel emissions using invoice spend amounts and kgCO2e per rupee factor, matching available ticket invoice data.

nodes.label: Weight-Based Operational Waste
nodes.rationale: Measures operational waste by weight from disposal certificates with disposal route field selecting route-specific factors.

nodes.label: Consolidation Query API

nodes.label: Configurable Not-Greater-Than Validation
nodes.rationale: Configurable validation rule checking part <= whole (women <= total, MSME spend <= total spend) to prevent invalid ratios.

nodes.label: Percentage Formula Type
nodes.rationale: Adds explicit percentage formula type (part / whole * 100, deviation D14) to derive percentages server-side from verified counts.

nodes.label: Role-Specific Non-Emission Metrics
nodes.rationale: Deploys metrics for HR (% women, % trained), EHS (water consumption), Procurement (MSME spend %), and Finance/CSR (CSR spend, penalties).

nodes.label: Single-Document Derived Metrics
nodes.rationale: Derives metric values from multiple fields within the same document, storing individual inputs in calculation_inputs for accurate consolidation.

nodes.label: Subtract Formula Type
nodes.rationale: Calculates water consumption as withdrawal minus discharge from a single water record using subtract formula type.

nodes.label: Water Consumption to Withdrawal Mapping
nodes.rationale: Water utility bill consumption lines map directly to Water Withdrawn; Water Discharged remains empty for manual user entry.

nodes.label: Indian Financial Year Consolidation Boundary
nodes.rationale: Consolidates reports across Indian FY (April 1 to March 31) to align with statutory BRSR reporting periods.

nodes.label: Metric-Specific Consolidation Rules
nodes.rationale: Calculated metrics sum results per unit; percentages re-derive from Σpart / Σwhole * 100; recorded amounts sum normalized values.

nodes.label: Bundle Proposal Classification Engine
nodes.rationale: Classifies pages per document type using keyword scores (document_bundle_parts); transitions create new bills, distinctive keywords propose activities.

nodes.label: Split Review Screen
nodes.rationale: Interactive review UI at /app/upload/split/[documentId] allowing uploaders to verify and adjust proposed page boundaries and activities.

nodes.label: DISCOM Electricity Extraction Rules
nodes.rationale: Rules-5 and rules-6 parse UNITS ADVANCED, BILL DT, and infer billing periods from previous/present meter-reading dates when labelled periods are absent.

nodes.label: DISCOM Utility Name Matching
nodes.rationale: Matches power utilities against KNOWN_UTILITIES with D/O fuzzy matching capped at 70 confidence to flag ambiguous readings for acknowledgement.

nodes.label: Renewable Electricity Metric
nodes.rationale: Configured as dedicated metric alongside Grid Electricity with distinct conversion factors, backed by Renewable Energy Certificate evidence.

nodes.label: Implied kWh Unit Rule
nodes.rationale: When consumption is found under a units label without explicit unit text, default to kWh at fixed 60 confidence (implied_by_label) to require human review.

nodes.label: Zero Conversion Factor Allowance
nodes.rationale: Permits conversion factor values of exactly 0 kgCO2e/kWh for market-based renewable reporting while requiring verified source citation.

nodes.label: Client-Side XLSX Parsing
nodes.rationale: Parses Excel sheets in browser using SheetJS and sends JSON rows via tRPC, avoiding unnecessary Storage bucket round trips when original files are not required.

nodes.label: Bundle Document Model
nodes.rationale: Uploaded multi-bill PDF is recorded as a parent document with documents.is_bundle=true (migration 0032, D24) without creating an ESG record directly.

nodes.label: Server-Side PDF Page Cutting
nodes.rationale: Cuts individual bills into distinct PDF files using pdf-lib with unique SHA-256 hashes and bundle_document_id pointing back to the original bundle.

nodes.label: Bulk Import Permissions
nodes.rationale: Introduces user.bulk_import and org.bulk_import permissions (migration 0029) to avoid hardcoding HR-only permissions, letting admins configure access via existing matrix.

nodes.label: Row-Level Import Transactions
nodes.rationale: Processes each spreadsheet row in its own transaction instead of an all-or-nothing batch, reusing single-invite validation and reachableNodeIds scoping.

nodes.label: Bundle Upload Guardrails
nodes.rationale: Enforces 20 pages max (BUNDLE_MAX_PAGES), 20 bills max, and 50MB per upload, charging bundle uploads against rate limits only once.

nodes.label: BRSR Readiness Tree Drill-Down
nodes.rationale: Interactive readiness tree on /admin/brsr-mapping navigating Section -> Indicator -> Metric -> Calculation -> Evidence with Complete/Partial/Missing status.

nodes.label: Mapping Applicability Flag
nodes.rationale: is_applicable flag on mapping table (deviation D15) allows admins to toggle indicator mappings without deleting configuration rows.

nodes.label: BRSR Readiness Composite Score
nodes.rationale: Computes weighted composite score from submission, evidence, validation, approval, and indicator readiness with transparent drawer breakdown.

nodes.label: Completion Pipeline KPIs
nodes.rationale: Formal definitions for Submission Completion, Evidence Coverage, Validation Completion, Approval Completion, and Scope Completion.

nodes.label: Submission Expectations Model
nodes.rationale: Configurable submission_expectations table (org unit x metric, deviation D16) establishes reporting denominator for monitoring completion.

nodes.label: URL-Driven Filter Context
nodes.rationale: Maintains selected org node and period context in URL query parameters, enabling deep linking and seamless filter preservation across screens.

nodes.label: App-Level Rate Limiting
nodes.rationale: rate_limit_events table (deviation D19) throttles failed sign-ins per account and IP, and throttles document upload preparations.

nodes.label: tRPC Origin CSRF Protection
nodes.rationale: Validates Origin and Sec-Fetch-Site headers on state-changing tRPC requests to protect endpoints from cross-site request forgery.

nodes.label: User-Stored Theme Preference
nodes.rationale: Persists theme preference in users.theme column (deviation D20), mirrored in localStorage with pre-paint script to prevent theme flash.

nodes.label: TopBar Theme Toggle Component
nodes.rationale: components/shell/theme-toggle.tsx mounts compact 3-swatch toggle directly in TopBar, removing the theme picker from Profile.

nodes.label: WCAG Contrast Token Adjustments
nodes.rationale: Adjusts brand colors that failed WCAG AA contrast (4.5:1 text, 3:1 controls) to nearest passing shades, documenting shifts in APP_FLOW_DEVIATIONS.md.

nodes.label: Theme-2 Corporate Default Selection
nodes.rationale: Sets theme-2 (Corporate blue/red/white) as column default in users.theme (migration 0031, deviation D23) and re-binds globals.css :root fallback.
